svg.text: COVERAGE GAP · SOURCE-BACKED STEP · NO SCREENSHOT

g.text: Touch the Stuffie Playroom picture door.
The existing campaign creates an isolated Main/Castle fixture and
shows the room directly. It does not prove the complete fresh-
save unlock route. Canonical MA-PLAY-005 remains open.
Any patient image is an existing asset reference, not a captured action or proposed redesign.
